# Exploratory Data Analysis For Beach FIB Only

This document includes the exploratory data analysis (EDA) of beach FIB concentrations on an annual and monthly basis.

```{r, message = false, warning = false}
# Load libraries 
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
library(slider)
library(scales)
library(janitor)
library(patchwork)
```

## **Heal The Bay Brand Colors**

This code assigns the the following colors to each FIB parameter: E. Coli, Enterococcus, Total Coliforms, and Fecal Coliforms.

```{r, message = false, warning = false}
htb_colors <- c(
  "E. Coli" = "#40B4EB",
  "Enterococcus" = "#2D94C8",
  "Total Coliforms" = "#8FA9B9",
  "Fecal Coliforms" = "#1479A9")
```

# Annual Beach FIB EDA

## **Mutating Beach Data Frames**

The data was mutated to add a year and month column for analysis. The mean, median, and variance was calculated for the log 10 transformed FIB concentrations grouped by each motioning station and year.

```{r}
# Read the data file
beach_data_2014_2024 <- read.csv(here("data","clean_master_beach_data_2014_2024.csv")) 

# Mutate the Beach Data 
beach_clean <- beach_data_2014_2024 |>
  mutate(result_log = log10(result), # log 10 transform the data
         sampledate = as.Date(sampledate), # change from chr to date
          year = year(sampledate),  # extract year from sampledate
          month = month(sampledate, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)) # extract month from sampledate

```

Results for greatest variance values and range:

-   The top 2 greatest variance values for **E.** **Coli** was in [2023]{.underline} (log10 var = 0.97) and [2024]{.underline} (log10 var = 0.88)

    -   Range: 0.15-0.97 for 10 years

-   The top 2 greatest variance values for **Enterococcus** was in [2023]{.underline} (log10 var = 0.58) and [2019]{.underline} (log10 var = 0.49)

    -   Range: 0.21-0.58

-   The top 2 greatest variance values for **Fecal Coliforms** was in [2019]{.underline} (log10 var = 0.55) and [2017]{.underline} (log10 var = 0.53)

    -   Range: 0.21-0.55

-   The top 2 greatest variance values for **Total Coliforms** was in [2023]{.underline} (log10 var = 1.12) and [2024]{.underline} (log10 var = 1.06)

    -   Range: 0.59-1.12

```{r}
# Creating a summary stats for each fib parameter for each station # for each year
beach_annual_station <- beach_clean |>
  group_by(stationname, parameter, year) |>
  summarise(
    annual_mean_log = mean(result_log, na.rm = TRUE),
    annual_median_log = median(result_log, na.rm = TRUE),
    annual_variance_log = var(result_log, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_samples = n(),
    .groups = "drop")


# Creating a summary stats for each fib parameter for each year
beach_annual_parameter <- beach_clean |>
  group_by(parameter, year) |>
  summarise(
    annual_mean_log = mean(result_log, na.rm = TRUE),
    annual_median_log = median(result_log, na.rm = TRUE),
    annual_variance_log = var(result_log, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_samples = n(),
    .groups = "drop")
```

The precipitation data is cleaned, mutated, and filtered to create 2 datasets: wet weather and dry weather.

```{r}
# Read in the Precipitation Data
precip_2014_2024 <- read.csv(here("data","precipitation_clean_2014_2024.csv")) 

# Mutate the Precip Data
precip_clean <- precip_2014_2024 |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date), # Change date from chr to date
         year = year(date), # extract the year from the date
         month = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE), # extract month from the date
         wet = prcp_in > 0.1) # defines wet weather as >0.1 inches

# Separate wet vs dry data
wet_weather <- precip_clean |>  
  filter(wet == TRUE)

dry_weather <- precip_clean |> 
  filter(wet == FALSE)


# Total the Annual Precipitation Each Year 
precip_annual <- precip_clean |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    total_rain_in = sum(prcp_in, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

# Join the Precipi Data with the FIB Concentrations Annual Data
join_prcp_fib_data <- beach_annual_station |>
  left_join(precip_annual, by = "year")
```

## Mean Annual Average FIB Concentrations

### E.Coli

#### Mean E.Coli Trends Across All Sites Annually

This code develops a box plot for all the FIB data points per year per station.

Goal: Understand annual distribution of E.Coli across all monitoring stations.

```{r}
# Create a new dataframe for only yearly e.coli concentrations
annual_ecoli <- beach_annual_station |>
  filter(parameter == "E. Coli")


# Summarize the mean e.coli value across all sizes
mean_total_ecoli <- annual_ecoli |> 
  summarise(mean_yr_ecoli = mean(annual_mean_log), na.rm = TRUE) |>
  pull(mean_yr_ecoli) # this extracts the numeric valye of the mean log10 entro event so that it can be plotted in ggplot

```

```{r}
# Create box plot
beach_ecoli_mean_annual_plot <- ggplot(annual_ecoli,
  aes(x = factor(year), y = annual_mean_log, fill = parameter)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = parameter),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0),
    size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = mean_total_ecoli, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1, color = "black")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = htb_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = htb_colors) +
  labs(title = "E. Coli",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean Log10 Concentration") +
  ylim(0.5, 3.5) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none")
beach_ecoli_mean_annual_plot

# Save the Plot 
#ggsave(here("outputs", "beach_fib_average_annually", #"beach_ecoli_annual_plot.png"),
#  plot = beach_ecoli_annual_plot, width = 15, height = 6, dpi = 400)
```

```{r}
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = parameter),

beach_ecoli_med_annual_plot
```

```{r}
# Summary Statistics
ecoli_summary_table <- annual_ecoli |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    min_ecoli = min(annual_median_log, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQ25_ecoli = quantile(annual_median_log, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ecoli = mean(annual_median_log, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_ecoli = median(annual_median_log, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQ75_ecoli = quantile(annual_median_log, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_ecoli = max(annual_median_log, na.rm = TRUE),
    var_ecoli = var(annual_median_log, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")
```

### Enterococcus

#### Mean Enterococcus Trends Across All Sites Annually

```{r}
annual_enterococcus <- beach_annual_station |>
  filter(parameter == "Enterococcus")

  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    total_samples = sum(n_samples),
    .groups = "drop")
```

# Pathworking Section

The four mean annual boxplots for the four FIB parameters: E. coli, enterococcus, total coliforms, and fecal coliforms were combined into one png for export for the report.

```{r}
combined_mean_annual_boxplots <- 
  (beach_ecoli_mean_annual_plot | beach_entero_mean_annual_plot) /
  (beach_tot_mean_annual_plot | beach_fec_mean_annual_plot)
combined_mean_annual_boxplots

# Save the plot
ggsave(here("outputs", "beach_fib_average_annually", "beach_annual_all.png"), plot = combined_mean_annual_boxplots, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 400)
```

# Beach FIB Average Monthly on a Year-to-Year Basis

[**Goal**]{.underline}: The purpose of this section is the understand how the average of FIB concentrations vary througout each month on a year to year basis. This can help us understand patterns between wet and dry months, and th effects on the monitoring stations.

## **2014 Yearly Box Plot**

### Mean

```{r}
#Create New Data Frame 
beach_2014 <- beach_clean |> 
  filter(year == 2014)

# Create the average values of each month in the year 2014
beach_monthly_2014 <- beach_2014 |> 
  group_by(stationname, parameter, month) |> 
  summarise(monthly_mean_log = mean(result_log, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_samples = n(), .groups = "drop") # Ungroups the values to allow for plotting)
```

```{r}
# Create box plot
beach_monthly_2014_box <- ggplot(beach_monthly_2014,
  aes(x = month, y = monthly_mean_log, fill = parameter)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +   # boxplot
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = parameter),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0),
    size = 1,alpha = 0.6) +                                               # points
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +  # 4 panels
  scale_fill_manual(values = htb_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = htb_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Average FIB Concentrations Across All Sites (2014)",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Monthly Mean Log10 Concentration") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none")
beach_monthly_2014_box

# Save the Plot 
#ggsave(filename = here("outputs", "beach_fib_average_monthly", #"beach_fib_monthly_2014_plot.png"),
#  plot = beach_monthly_2014_box, width = 21, height = 12, dpi = 400)
```

```{r}
  summarise(monthly_mean_log = mean(result_log, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_samples = n(), .groups = "drop") # Ungroups the values to allow for plotting)
```

```{r}
# Create box plot
beach_monthly_2018_box <- ggplot(beach_monthly_2018,
  aes(x = month, y = monthly_mean_log, fill = parameter)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +   # boxplot
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = parameter),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0),
    size = 1,alpha = 0.6) +                                               # points
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +  # 4 panels
  scale_fill_manual(values = htb_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = htb_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Average FIB Concentrations Across All Sites (2018)",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Monthly Mean Log10 Concentration") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none")
beach_monthly_2018_box

# Save the Plot 
#ggsave(filename = here("outputs", "beach_fib_average_monthly", #"beach_fib_monthly_2018_plot.png"),
#  plot = beach_monthly_2018_box, width = 21, height = 12, dpi = 400)
```
